pages.title: Where Vehicles Go
pages.text: This pack has trains, airships, submarines, rockets and roller coasters. Each one has places that are worth reaching with it. This entry is the map of who goes where.

**Trains** link your bases and farms over long distances. Create: Power Loader can keep a station's area loaded.

[#](2E5AAC)[Trains](entry://transport/trains)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Power Loader](entry://industry/power_loader)[#]().

**Airships** reach sky villages, floating ruins and soaring structures that you can't easily climb to. Watch out for Hostile Skies' raiders and the cold of altitude.

[#](2E5AAC)[Flight Destinations](entry://flight/destinations)[#]().

**Space:** a Northstar rocket goes to the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. An Aeronautics ship can make the jump too with a Dimensional Drive (or the Stellar Navigator). Every way up needs a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/why)[#]().

[#](2E5AAC)[Reaching Space](entry://space/reaching_space)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Ships to Space](entry://space/aeronautics_bridge)[#]().

**Submarines** reach ruins, shipwrecks, ocean monuments and the deep, where pressure and air become the problem.

[#](2E5AAC)[Submarines](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Underwater Places](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#]().

**Roller coasters** go nowhere in particular. That is the point.

[#](2E5AAC)[Roller Coasters](entry://transport/coasters)[#]().
